findings.title: Session cookie not HttpOnly
findings.message: Session cookie has httpOnly: false — readable by JavaScript, vulnerable to XSS.
findings.remediation: Set httpOnly: true on all session cookies.

findings.title: Session cookie not Secure in production
findings.message: Session cookie has secure: false — transmitted over HTTP in plaintext.

findings.title: No MFA implementation found
findings.message: Authentication code present but no TOTP/OTP/MFA library detected.
findings.snippet: // VULN: No rate limiting on login (AUTH004)
findings.remediation: Consider adding TOTP-based MFA (speakeasy, otplib) for high-value accounts.

findings.title: JWT missing expiry (expiresIn)
findings.message: JWT signed without expiresIn — tokens never expire, extending breach window indefinitely.
findings.snippet: const token = jwt.sign({ userId: results[0].id, role: 'admin' }, JWT_SECRET);
findings.remediation: Add expiresIn: '15m' (access) and '7d' (refresh) to jwt.sign() options.

findings.title: No CSRF protection found
findings.message: Mutating route detected. Verify CSRF tokens (csurf / double-submit cookie) are enforced.
findings.remediation: Use the csurf package or implement double-submit cookie pattern on state-changing routes.

findings.title: Password reset token not time-limited
findings.message: Password reset token generated without visible expiry.
findings.snippet: const resetToken = Math.random().toString(36); // VULN: Math.random is not cryptographically secure
findings.remediation: Reset tokens must expire within 15–60 minutes. Store hash + expiry timestamp.

findings.title: No MFA implementation found
findings.message: Authentication code present but no TOTP/OTP/MFA library detected.
findings.remediation: Consider adding TOTP-based MFA (speakeasy, otplib) for high-value accounts.
